raw_label_is_wrong.raw_note: the gate mechanism exercised on the sealed v7 development set. This is not the v8 pre-arm verdict and is not a paper endpoint. Protocol section 7 requires the harness to be proven here so that a defect does not spend holdout titles.

corrections.why_the_raw_label_is_wrong: entity_conditioned_gate_v8.py has no run-class parameter. It was written when only development data existed and hard-codes DEVELOPMENT_ONLY together with a note saying the input is the sealed v7 development set.

corrections.approved_sentence: The v8 development set passed the frozen tie-rate criterion (7.34%), whereas the untouched confirmatory holdout exceeded the predeclared 10% ceiling (19/166, 11.45%).

imprecise_field_in_a_prior_receipt.not_edited: that receipt's digest is bound by the endpoint seal completion note, so it is corrected here by appending rather than by editing.
